LanguageData.Gun_PP-19_Bizon-2_RWP.label: PP-19 Bizon-2
LanguageData.Gun_PP-19_Bizon-2_RWP.description: The PP-19 Bizon-2 is a Russian-made submachine gun known for its unique helical magazine, allowing for a high capacity of 64 rounds. Lightweight and compact, it excels in close-quarters combat, providing a rapid rate of fire that can quickly suppress threats. Ideal for raids or defense in confined spaces.
